name: Bulki, kefir i rock-n-roll
source:
No sooner had the protagonist gotten somewhat used to the camp than a new disaster struck: the concert for the closing of the shift is on the verge of cancellation, and it's all his fault. The band needs a new bassist, and the music club makes Semyon an offer he cannot refuse. And he wouldn't want to anyway, because Miku will personally take charge of his training.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=451835368]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角刚适应营地，新的灾难就降临了：结束班次的音乐会即将取消，而这一切都是他的错。乐队需要一名新贝斯手，音乐俱乐部向谢苗提出了一个他无法拒绝的提议。反正他也不愿意，因为Miku会亲自负责他的训练。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=451835368]Steam[/url]]
